senses.def: a short coat with sleeves
senses.ex: Take a jacket, it's cold outside.
senses.exPt: Leva uma jaqueta, está frio lá fora.

senses.def: a hard green stone used for jewellery
senses.ex: She bought a beautiful jade necklace in China.
senses.exPt: Ela comprou um colar de jade lindo na China.

senses.def: a place where criminals are kept as a punishment
senses.ex: He spent two years in jail for robbery.
senses.exPt: Ele passou dois anos na prisão por roubo.

senses.def: a sweet food made from fruit and sugar that you put on bread
senses.ex: I had toast with strawberry jam for breakfast.
senses.exPt: Comi torrada com geleia de morango no café da manhã.

senses.def: a long line of cars that cannot move (traffic jam)
senses.ex: We were stuck in a traffic jam for two hours.
senses.exPt: Ficamos presos num engarrafamento por duas horas.

senses.def: the first month of the year
senses.ex: It's very hot in Rio in January.
senses.exPt: Faz muito calor no Rio em janeiro.

senses.def: a glass container with a lid, used for storing food
senses.ex: Can you open this jar of jam for me?
senses.exPt: Você pode abrir este pote de geleia para mim?

senses.def: the lower part of your face that moves when you speak or eat
senses.ex: My jaw dropped when I saw the price.
senses.exPt: Fiquei de queixo caído quando vi o preço.

senses.def: a type of music with strong rhythms, first played by African Americans
senses.ex: My father loves listening to jazz.
senses.exPt: Meu pai adora ouvir jazz.

senses.def: unhappy because someone you love seems interested in another person
senses.ex: He gets jealous when his girlfriend talks to other men.
senses.exPt: Ele fica com ciúme quando a namorada conversa com outros homens.

senses.def: wanting something that another person has
senses.ex: I'm so jealous of your trip to Japan!
senses.exPt: Estou com inveja da sua viagem ao Japão!

senses.def: in a way that shows you are jealous
senses.ex: He watched jealously as she danced with another man.
senses.exPt: Ele olhava com ciúme enquanto ela dançava com outro homem.

senses.def: very carefully, so that others cannot have or know something
senses.ex: The family recipe is a jealously guarded secret.
senses.exPt: A receita da família é um segredo guardado a sete chaves.

senses.def: trousers made of strong blue cotton
senses.ex: I usually wear jeans and a T-shirt at the weekend.
senses.exPt: Eu normalmente uso calça jeans e camiseta no fim de semana.

senses.def: a soft sweet food made from fruit juice and sugar that shakes when you move it
senses.ex: The kids had jelly and ice cream for dessert.
senses.exPt: As crianças comeram gelatina e sorvete de sobremesa.

senses.def: a sweet food made from fruit and sugar that you spread on bread
senses.ex: I had a peanut butter and jelly sandwich for lunch.
senses.exPt: Comi um sanduíche de pasta de amendoim com geleia no almoço.

senses.def: to put something in danger of being harmed or lost
senses.ex: Don't do anything that could jeopardize your career.
senses.exPt: Não faça nada que possa colocar em risco sua carreira.

senses.exPt: Os torcedores compraram as novas camisas vermelhas do time.

senses.ex: She bought a comfortable jersey dress for the trip.
senses.exPt: Ela comprou um vestido de malha confortável para a viagem.

senses.def: a fast plane with engines that push out hot air

senses.exPt: A família rica voou para Paris num jato particular.

senses.def: a valuable stone, such as a diamond

senses.def: things like rings and necklaces that you wear as decoration

senses.exPt: Ela guarda as joias dela numa caixinha.

senses.def: the work you do regularly to earn money
senses.ex: My sister is looking for a new job.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã está procurando um novo emprego.

senses.def: a piece of work that you do
senses.ex: You did a great job on the kitchen!
senses.exPt: Você fez um ótimo trabalho na cozinha!

senses.def: to run slowly for exercise
senses.ex: I jog in the park every morning before work.
senses.exPt: Eu corro no parque toda manhã antes do trabalho.

senses.def: running slowly for exercise
senses.ex: I go jogging in the park every morning.
senses.exPt: Eu vou correr no parque toda manhã.

senses.def: to become a member of a group or club
senses.ex: I want to join the football club at school.
senses.exPt: Quero entrar no clube de futebol da escola.

senses.def: to go somewhere to be with other people
senses.ex: Would you like to join us for dinner?
senses.exPt: Você quer se juntar a nós no jantar?

senses.def: shared or done by two or more people
senses.ex: My wife and I have a joint bank account.
senses.exPt: Minha esposa e eu temos uma conta conjunta.

senses.exPt: Correr todo dia pode fazer mal para as articulações.

senses.def: a short funny story that you tell to make people laugh
senses.ex: He told a funny joke at dinner.
senses.exPt: Ele contou uma piada engraçada no jantar.

senses.def: to say something funny that is not serious or true
senses.ex: Don't worry, I'm only joking.
senses.exPt: Relaxa, só estou brincando.

senses.def: a serious magazine about a particular subject
senses.ex: She published her research in a medical journal.
senses.exPt: Ela publicou a pesquisa numa revista médica.

senses.def: a book where you write about what happens each day
senses.ex: I keep a journal and write in it every night.
senses.exPt: Eu tenho um diário e escrevo nele toda noite.

senses.def: the work of collecting and writing news for newspapers, TV or websites
senses.ex: She studied journalism at university.
senses.exPt: Ela estudou jornalismo na faculdade.

senses.def: a person who writes news for newspapers, websites, TV or radio
senses.ex: She works as a journalist for a local newspaper.
senses.exPt: Ela trabalha como jornalista num jornal local.

senses.def: the act of travelling from one place to another, especially a long way
senses.ex: The journey from London to Paris takes two hours by train.
senses.exPt: A viagem de Londres a Paris leva duas horas de trem.

senses.def: the trip you make regularly, for example to work
senses.ex: My journey to work takes about forty minutes.
senses.exPt: Meu trajeto até o trabalho leva uns quarenta minutos.

senses.def: a feeling of great happiness
senses.ex: Her face was full of joy.
senses.exPt: O rosto dela estava cheio de alegria.

senses.def: to form an opinion about someone or something
senses.ex: You shouldn't judge people by their clothes.
senses.exPt: Você não deveria julgar as pessoas pelas roupas.

senses.def: a person who decides how criminals are punished in a court
senses.ex: The judge sent him to prison for two years.
senses.exPt: O juiz o mandou para a prisão por dois anos.

senses.def: the ability to make good decisions
senses.ex: Use your judgment and do what you think is right.
senses.exPt: Use o seu bom senso e faça o que achar certo.

senses.def: an opinion you form after thinking carefully
senses.ex: In my judgment, she is the best person for the job.
senses.exPt: Na minha opinião, ela é a melhor pessoa para o cargo.

senses.def: a Japanese sport in which two people fight and try to throw each other
senses.ex: My son has judo classes twice a week.
senses.exPt: Meu filho tem aula de judô duas vezes por semana.

senses.def: a container with a handle used for pouring liquids
senses.ex: Can you bring a jug of water to the table?
senses.exPt: Você pode trazer uma jarra de água para a mesa?

senses.def: the liquid from fruit or vegetables, used as a drink
senses.ex: Would you like some apple juice?
senses.exPt: Você quer um pouco de suco de maçã?

senses.def: containing a lot of juice
senses.ex: These oranges are really sweet and juicy.
senses.exPt: Essas laranjas são bem doces e suculentas.

senses.def: the seventh month of the year
senses.ex: The school holidays start in July.
senses.exPt: As férias escolares começam em julho.

senses.ex: The kids jumped into the pool.
senses.exPt: As crianças pularam na piscina.

senses.def: a warm piece of clothing with sleeves for the top of the body (British English)
senses.ex: Put on a jumper, it's cold outside.
senses.exPt: Coloca um suéter, está frio lá fora.

senses.def: the sixth month of the year
senses.ex: My sister is getting married in June.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã vai se casar em junho.

senses.def: a thick tropical forest
senses.ex: Tigers and monkeys live in the jungle.
senses.exPt: Tigres e macacos vivem na selva.

senses.def: having a low position in a job or organization

senses.exPt: Ela conseguiu um emprego como designer júnior.

senses.def: for or about young people, especially in sports
senses.ex: He plays for the junior team at his school.
senses.exPt: Ele joga no time juvenil da escola.

senses.def: old or useless things that you do not want
senses.ex: The garage is full of old junk.
senses.exPt: A garagem está cheia de tralha velha.

senses.def: food that is quick and tasty but not healthy
senses.ex: I try not to eat junk food late at night.
senses.exPt: Eu tento não comer porcaria tarde da noite.

senses.def: the official power to make legal decisions in a particular area
senses.ex: The case is outside the jurisdiction of this court.
senses.exPt: O caso está fora da jurisdição deste tribunal.

senses.def: a member of a jury in a court
senses.ex: One of the jurors fell asleep during the trial.
senses.exPt: Um dos jurados dormiu durante o julgamento.

senses.def: a group of people who decide if someone is guilty in a court
senses.ex: The jury found him not guilty.
senses.exPt: O júri o considerou inocente.

senses.def: only; nothing more than
senses.ex: Don't worry, it's just a small problem.
senses.exPt: Não se preocupe, é só um probleminha.

senses.def: a very short time ago
senses.ex: I've just arrived home.
senses.exPt: Acabei de chegar em casa.

senses.def: exactly
senses.ex: That's just what I wanted!
senses.exPt: É exatamente o que eu queria!

senses.def: fair treatment of people, or the system of law
senses.ex: The families of the victims want justice.
senses.exPt: As famílias das vítimas querem justiça.

senses.def: to give a good reason for something
senses.ex: How can you justify spending so much money on shoes?
senses.exPt: Como você justifica gastar tanto dinheiro com sapatos?

senses.def: for a good reason; deservedly
senses.ex: She is justly proud of what her children have achieved.
senses.exPt: Ela tem orgulho, com razão, do que os filhos conquistaram.

senses.def: in a fair way
senses.ex: Everyone deserves to be treated justly by the courts.
senses.exPt: Todo mundo merece ser tratado com justiça pelos tribunais.

senses.def: connected with young people who are not yet adults
senses.ex: The city has seen a rise in juvenile crime.
senses.exPt: A cidade teve um aumento da criminalidade juvenil.

senses.def: silly and typical of a child
senses.ex: Stop being so juvenile and listen to me.
senses.exPt: Para de ser tão infantil e me escuta.

senses.def: a young person who is not yet an adult, especially in law
senses.ex: The court cannot publish the names of juveniles.
senses.exPt: O tribunal não pode divulgar o nome de menores de idade.
